subject.title: iOS app: node requests re-approval on every reconnect (token persistence bug)

question: Should this issue remain open for a current-main iOS LAN/VPN reconnect proof, or is the merged LAN bootstrap-token persistence fix enough to close it now?
rationale: The source proves a partial fix and a separate possible reapproval trigger, but only a live iOS reconnect run can tell whether the exact reported loop still occurs.

options.title: Keep open for iOS proof
options.body: Run a current-main iOS app against a LAN/VPN token-auth gateway, approve once, restart/reconnect several times, and inspect gateway node status/logs before closing.

options.title: Close as covered by bootstrap fix
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept that the QR/AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING repair sufficiently explains the observed repeated reapproval loop.

recommendation.title: Keep open for iOS proof
recommendation.body: Run a current-main iOS app against a LAN/VPN token-auth gateway, approve once, restart/reconnect several times, and inspect gateway node status/logs before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and contributed to the closest current-main iOS bootstrap-auth repair and is the best routed owner for deciding whether that proof is enough.
